name: Viridis Mining and Minerals Limited
summary: Viridis Mining and Minerals Limited engages in the acquisition, development, exploration, and evaluation of mineral properties in Australia, Canada, and Brazil. The company explores for gold, copper, nickel, copper, platinum, kaolin, and halloysite deposits, as well as rare earth elements. Its flagship project is the Colossus project located in the State of Minas Gerais, Brazil. The company was formerly known as Aus Asia Minerals Limited and changed its name to Viridis Mining and Minerals Limited in July 2021. Viridis Mining and Minerals Limited was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in Perth, Australia.
